Left foot comfortably forward and right foot behind, feet also separated laterally hip-width so stance is not a tightrope. Both hands grasp the horns of ONE small light neutral-gray kettlebell held CLOSE to sternum, elbows comfortably bent down; do not extend weight away. Pelvis stays broadly facing along feet; ribcage and shoulders rotate a SMALL comfortable 20–25 degrees toward the forward-leg side, head follows naturally, clear slight difference between shoulder line and pelvic line. Maintain upright spine, no extreme twist or backbend, knees aligned with toes, both feet stable. One static phase, no stepping, no overhead raise, no slant board.
